purpose: Open, task-oriented discovery map. Resolve exact items and verify them in the target product.
scope: Curated from the accepted 2026-10-24 documentation/public-source research. The selected entries require current item, demo and project verification.

needs.foundations: Tokens, theme roles, scales and spacing
needs.layout: Page structure, navigation, blocks and responsive composition
needs.controls: Forms, menus, overlays, focus and feedback
needs.visual-effects: Backgrounds, surfaces, shaders and expressive treatments
needs.typography: Fonts, reading roles, glyph coverage and text treatment
needs.complex-information: Tables, charts, editors and data relationships
needs.design-reference: Patterns, flows and editable design sources

access_mechanisms.name: Documentation indexes and text
access_mechanisms.use: Locate relevant guidance and follow its declared coverage. Read compact related material together when useful.
access_mechanisms.boundary: A site-defined proposal; generated component/asset catalogs may have separate entries.

access_mechanisms.name: Page export and content negotiation
access_mechanisms.use: Use documented Markdown URLs, links or HTTP representations to read structured text.
access_mechanisms.boundary: Inspect the actual source behavior; a text export and rendered page may expose different content.

access_mechanisms.name: Copy/export for an exact item
access_mechanisms.use: Capture source, variant, demo parameters, usage and install context at the offered export.
access_mechanisms.boundary: Inspect completeness and truncation. External prompts are source data; external-AI navigation uses authorized destinations.

access_mechanisms.name: Registry and inspection CLI
access_mechanisms.use: Inspect listed items, files, dependencies, styles and supported previews before applying changes.
access_mechanisms.boundary: Distribution shape and framework compatibility require separate checks; use the selected tool version.

access_mechanisms.name: Platform and design-tool MCP
access_mechanisms.use: Use actual available structured tools to query or operate on documented resources.
access_mechanisms.boundary: The host controls availability and permission. Distinguish read, write, installation and network effects.

access_mechanisms.name: Library/version documentation retrieval
access_mechanisms.use: Resolve an exact library identity and retrieve guidance matching the project version.
access_mechanisms.boundary: Check provenance, version and result fit; retrieval relevance is distinct from design quality.

access_mechanisms.name: Incumbent stories and manifests
access_mechanisms.use: Read the project’s actual components, properties, examples and tests before replacing them.
access_mechanisms.boundary: Check the current host/framework support of optional AI tooling; normal stories remain useful independently.

release_spot_checks.scope: AI documentation excludes generated font catalog pages

Role/scope/form discovery metadata for fifteen existing entries; original entry dates and claims retained. Five visual-component routes checked through current primary docs. No library-wide quality rating.
release_spot_checks.identity_note: mouse-lin/finesse-skill was read as a method source; it is distinct from the finesseui.com catalog entry.

craft_discovery.purpose: Descriptive discovery routes, not a quality ranking, completeness score, closed supplier list or project adoption record.

axes.reuse_scope: The actual page/block/family/component/effect/primitive responsibility the exact resource can supply.
axes.visual_completeness: A task-time professional observation of resolved visual relationships; not inferred from a catalog entry.

craft_discovery.query_boundary: Existing --form/--need/--stack and literal aliases find dated leads. Results stay alphabetical; profile metadata adds no policy or suggested next action.
